name: udp-association-head-count-flake
title: Diagnose the UDP association head count flake
description: Part 3 of the operator's 'fix all suspicious tests' item. Observed once in 13 full-suite runs of 09-30-exact-gate-residual-lumps: UdpAssociationHeadTests.TheDefaultHeadKeepsTheAcceptanceLoadShared failed at UdpAssociationHeadTests.cs:110 with Expected: 282, Actual: 281 on server.AssociateReplyCount — NOT on pool.AssociationCount, whose assertion at :104 passed along with :103/:105/:109, so the pool's sharing shape (282 associations, 4,500 leases) was intact. The fake SOCKS5 UDP server increments its ASSOCIATE-reply counter after the reply write (ScriptedSocks5UdpServer.cs:185-186) while the client's rent completes when it reads the reply, so the counter can lag by a scheduling window under suite load. Ten direct assertions in five files depend on it (the review chain's earlier counts of 8 and then 9-in-4 were both wrong; PoolTests.cs:276 was dropped). Fix: publish the counter before the reply is readable, prove it with a blocked-write deterministic test, and correct the archive record and journal that misattributed the failure to the pool.
